_doc: Example DCE run config for data in BIDS layout. Copy it, point the two folders at your
own session, and edit. See dce_run_example_nonbids.json for data that is not in BIDS.
A run config says which data to process and only the settings this run overrides. Every
other knob resolves from python/dce_defaults.json, the single source for defaults, limits
and preferences. Restating a default here would fork it, so keys whose value matches the
What makes this the BIDS form: naming the session folders is enough. Notice there are no
file lists and no acquisition parameters below.
- The images and masks are found under 'subject_tp_path' by the dceprep naming
optional anat/*label-noise_mask.nii*. Each is logged as it is found. To use a
different file, name it outright -- an explicit list always wins over the convention.
- TR, flip angle, temporal resolution and relaxivity are read from the acquisition
Both folders are optional in general; they are what buys the two conveniences above, so a
config that omits them has to name its files and state its parameters, as the non-BIDS
example does. 'drift_files' is never discovered: it has no naming convention.
